messages.subject: BCPG | Renewable growth, partnerships and regional stakeholder leadership
messages.body:
Dear BCPG Leadership Team,

BCPG's renewable-energy growth across Thailand and the region aligns closely with my experience at the intersection of clean energy, institutions and industrial execution.

I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate covers government and regulatory engagement, ESG, social performance, corporate coordination and executive stakeholder strategy.

My recent work includes stakeholder and governance support around approximately 46 to 50 MWp of solar capacity and more than 80 MWh of battery storage, together with carbon-data readiness from physical operating records. I also manage formal regulator engagement, community priorities and cross-functional follow-through on operating commitments.

I would welcome consideration for Thailand or regional mandates across External Affairs, Sustainability, Strategic Partnerships, Government Relations or country-facing leadership. I have attached a BCPG-focused executive CV and would appreciate your forwarding it to the relevant executive team.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
